name: Pets in Need - Low-Cost Vet Services
description: Affordable wellness care, low-cost vaccines, and low-cost spay/neuter
fullDescription: Pets in Need runs a Community Veterinary Clinic in Redwood City for affordable wellness care, plus a low-cost vaccine clinic and spay/neuter clinic at its Palo Alto shelter.
whatTheyOffer:
- Community Veterinary Clinic (Redwood City): wellness consultations ($85), vaccines, flea/tick and heartworm prevention, microchipping, deworming, and basic tests
- Community Clinic is for wellness visits only (no x-rays, dental, surgery, or emergency care)
- Walk-in vaccine clinic (Palo Alto): every Wednesday 9:30-11:30 am, first come first served; most vaccines $25, microchips $30
- Low-cost spay/neuter surgeries for cats and dogs (Palo Alto), open to residents of any city; $100 deposit to book
howToGetIt:
1. Book a Community Clinic appointment online (Thursdays, by appointment only)
2. For vaccines, bring your pet to the Palo Alto shelter (3281 E. Bayshore Rd) on a Wednesday morning
3. For spay/neuter, book online and pay the deposit; pets must be at least 4 months old
4. Pay remaining fees at time of service
keywords: Pets in Need, low-cost vet, Redwood City, Palo Alto, spay, neuter, vaccinations, microchip, wellness exam, San Mateo, affordable vet
